_comment: S2-v2 strong teacher (a, seed 2) - BACKLOG B-21 pre-registered 2026-10-15. One teacher per GPU; the ensemble averages their logits (a calibration lever). LoRA r32/a64, 5 epochs @ 2e-5 with 5% warmup, gradient checkpointing ON after the no-checkpointing run OOM'd (peak ~20GB + fragmentation; expandable_segments set at launch), criterion-presentation augmentation 50/50 (key: description vs bare description).
